source_evidence:
PLAYER EXACT request "Lets stay for 3 days, to get a full rest, and pay for it all. We can use the three days to review the evidence and assess what to do with it." Authorized booking of THREE consecutive safe-town WAYHOUSE NIGHTS D282→283, D283→284, D284→285, three days of available food/care and one optional available private bed for party shelter, while preserving user agency over any later travel, disclosures or special investigative expenses. PREPARED Sedgecross keeper offered common-room 12 floor pallets4gp/night, exactly one free private room/bed5sp/night (other room already occupied), 2sp/meal, 2gp one initial group sick-tender assessment and dressings. Keeper, independently mindful of safety, agrees to ordinary humanitarian shelter and paid meals, NOT concealing Veyran fugitives, armed protection, immunity or special legal status; no deception by V, no promise of silence. Use preexisting common room at11 patient floor pallets plus Cirren on12th; Mara independently uses rented single private bed, Fenar voluntarily camps in the coach under blankets in staffed wayhouse yard, V Reborn sits motionless in common-room chair (no fifth standard bed magically created). Coach and FOUR V-owned horses stabled and fed by wayhouse for established comparable ordinary4-horse town stable/feed charge2gp/night x3=6gp, as its on-site agreed quoted rate for these horses; this is a NEW negotiated ordinary stable price grounded in earlier paid Caer Veylan four-horse fee. No V carried feed charge while stables feed purchased. Booking common3x4gp=12gp; private available single bed3x5sp=1gp5sp; initial experienced NONMAGICAL sick-tender group evaluation with ordinary dressings once2gp; 11 patients + 3 eating companions Mara/Cirren/Fenar =14 people, V Reborn no food, 9 meal services over actual stay (D282 afternoon+supper2; D283 all3; D284 all3; D285 breakfast1), 14x9=126 meals x2sp=252sp=25gp2sp; covered basic drinking water/blankets. Routine minor follow-up observation/dressing over three days included by caring sick-tender in accepted original initial assessment and no separate second fee charged; no medicine/potion/staff wage extra. Grand total12gp +1gp5sp +2gp +25gp2sp +6gp=46gp7sp exactly, no gratuity/charter or private-bed second-room; personally paid from V purse969gp3sp6cp →922gp6sp6cp, only ONCE, fully settled as instructed. Consumable carried rations9 person-days and horse feed12 animal-days remain unchanged because purchased food and feed, no payment for any V property/service outside quoted stay.

Day282 ~15:15 original unnamed Sedgecross wayhouse sick-tender, experienced NONMAGICAL civilian per approved prep, is hired with fees above and given consent from injured individuals; checks all11 and carefully examines prone P7–P9, cleans/dresses existing wounds, manages water/warmth/comfort and warns they still require prolonged care/flat transport, no invented deadly condition, magic restoration, HP gains or miraculous recovery. All11 are willing to stay for care, do not forcibly testify or sign legal papers. Eight ambulatory persons remain mobile, P7/P8/P9 remain unable to walk by dawn285, their discomfort eases with ordinary nursing and meals but no unearned mechanics/stats. Individual patients retain freedom to leave later or select care; common-room lodging for three nights not a permanent sanctuary. No sick-tender identity/name or license invented. Neither Corven nor station authorities learn the wayhouse location through an automatic connection; no official visit, combat or pursuit observed during the quiet three-day local recovery. Town is genuine staffed Sedgecross hamlet at junction of receiving road with wayhouse, ordinary safe-town setting, not isolated farm/roadside camp. No ordinary OVERLAND d100 travel encounter checks because party did NOT travel during this stay, no exposed-night random camp checks because sleeping at secured staffed Sedgecross wayhouse/yard; do not invent dice or claim pre-rolled events. Companions remain independently cooperative without loss of significant gameplay resources.

User expressly wants to use three days to "review the evidence and assess what to do with it." Review the ACTUAL already secured V-held ORIGINAL documentary records plus independently held Mara interview notes; no extra investigator magically manifests. D282 evening–D284 daytime V reviews in presence of willing Mara/Cirren/Fenar (do not script V's direct speech/commitment), with document pages carefully replaced in original sleeves maintaining their official seals; Fenar's six sealed reagent vials and silver-fitted measuring instrument remain separate in Fenar custody untouched/unappraised. Source support exact: two V-held original administration folios show SIX person IDs classified as discharged but among ELEVEN actual residents; original signed local trial/observation/injury packet ties procedures to patient harm; vault original bureau-sealed Kestrel authorization bearing CORVEN NASK name establishes real regional Western Service Directorate supervisory authorization for site special medical operation; two original EVERMARCH (endurance/pain trials) and CLEAR WILL (compelled behavioral reconditioning) controlled research order sets explicitly endorse restraint and proceeding despite subject refusal; original secure transfers/requisition ledger correlates names/case references/supplies and already-contradicted discharge entries. Patient P4's earlier voluntary statement that he never signed/left despite 'discharge' and involuntary treatments, other patients' first-person accounts and Mara's independent voluntary Neri interview notes form separate corroborating testimony. Taken together originals+living witnesses support coerced experiments, false discharge records, Kestrel staff involvement and station-level regional bureau backing. Their evidence does NOT identify exact senior signers of abuse authorization above local director, whether top political leaders KNEW individual offenses, full Western Program leadership, responsibility for gods' historical deaths, or another unplayed conspiracy; do NOT reveal DM-only truth, invent signatures/dates/travel stamps/further source documents or assert all Veyrans culpable. Only already-read originals are used. No formal written affidavits demanded, no public announcement, new government report, copies, recruitment, payment, or transfer of originals: player has not chosen those. Companions independent reasoning: Cirren emphasizes physical/medical care first and separates witness accounts from official administrative proof; Mara notes danger of giving only originals to an implicated chain and suggests preserve custody/independent, responsible review with patient consent; Fenar angrily objects to written permission for forced procedures, believes authors should be held responsible but doesn't dictate murder or scripted V action. They agree evidence is stronger together than scattered but cannot guarantee an outcome. Choices to offer to V at end: keep originals while seeking credible OUTSIDE oversight and survivor/independent recovery-home support (uncontacted Caer Veylan civilian trustee remains merely possible), seek legal official investigation with threat of military exposure, protect originals/arrange voluntary statement copies, and plan continuing medically appropriate placement. No trustee introduced or reward paid, no named city official conjured; return to Nightglass remains V-led future decision and earlier long journey not reset.

Weighted LONG REST progress1/6 from D281→282 peaceful WILDERNESS night, prior Day281 combat reset earlier5/6. Actual three consecutive undisturbed SAFE-TOWN Sedgecross overnight credits D282→283 +2 =>3/6, D283→284 +2 =>5/6, D284→285 +2 => COMPLETE six-unit Long Rest on Day285 dawn (weighted cap6/6, no double-counting any Short Rest). No interrupted overnight and no significant adventuring damage or resource spending. Upon actual completed LONG REST at D285 dawn V HP48/48 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi0→6/6, PastLife0→3/3, free Psychic Whispers0→1/1, MP7/7, PsiRecovery1/1, ActionSurge1/1, SecondWind1/1; no Psychic Whispers reactivation/link or new use. FenarHP59/59, HD5→6/6 (recover missing1 under 2014 half HD), Rage2→4/4, Shift3/3, MP6/6, BestialSoul CLIMB40 retained (can select adaptation at rest independently, chooses practical climb), no active Rage/Beast form. Cirren51/51, HD6/6, spells all full, Channel Divinity2/2; Mara healthy and four horses/coach intact. Weighted LongRest complete6/6; no spare overflow unit for next cycle. Town night rest requires no random travel checks, no claims of unearned XP, level, automatic medical HP cure, bonus encounter or loot. Personal estate/check-in routine messages are not used as an excuse for new transactions or future V speech; no extraordinary estate events adjudicated here. Current in-fiction checkpoint DAY285 around08:30 after paid breakfast, before group chooses next move; remaining three stretcher patients still need real continuing care and likely transport, keeper sold only three nights, no future lodging booked or authorization to hand documents to any institution.
pending_action: Day285 ~08:30 Sedgecross wayhouse after exact V authorized THREE nights D282→283, D283→284, D284→285, ALL bills PAID, evidence reviewed privately without report/disclosure or custody change. 11 rescued patients lodged in staffed common room on original stretchers/pallets, including3 P7–P9 still cannot walk and require continuing care. Civilian sick-tender made initial assessment and ordinary dressings, no magic or invented cures; all11 stable, cared for, free. Keeper accepts ordinary paid lodging not military concealment, no official search/attack observed; no magical guarantees. Three qualifying safe-town nights LongRest1→3→5→6/6 COMPLETE at dawn285, NOT until third night; No random travel/night encounter rolls because stationary town inn. V HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1, free Psychic Whispers1/1 not activated; FenarHP59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage INACTIVE4/4 uses Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40, Cirren51/51 full L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3 CD2/2, Mara and4 V horses/coach healthy. Bill settled from personal purse969gp3sp6cp→922gp6sp6cp (46gp7sp): 3 common nights12gp, 1 private bed three nights1gp5sp, initial medical group assessment/dressings2gp, 14 eaters x9 meal services at2sp=126 meals25gp2sp, four-horse stable/feed at2gp/night3 nights6gp; no carried provision debit, ration-person-days9/horse-feed-days12 remain. Evidence: V retains original two conflicting discharge/occupancy folios (six falsely discharged of eleven), signed lab trial/injury packet, original bureau-sealed Kestrel authorization with Corven Nask name, controlled EVERMARCH and CLEAR WILL experiments explicitly tolerating nonconsenting restraint, original transfer/requisition ledger and magister mundane component pouch. Mara keeps her earlier Neri witness interview notes; Fenar keeps six sealed reagent vials (2 ink,2 refined crystal,2 preservation salts) in padded case and silver-fitted tool unappraised. Source comparison establishes coercive Kestrel experiments, falsified discharge records, local/regional bureau institution link; DOES NOT prove command decisions of higher politicians or divine-death links. Cirren supports independent survivor care, Mara urges safe evidence custody and an independent recipient, Fenar wants culpable organizers held responsible; none chooses V's official report/next travel. No copy, affidavit, sale, reward or external official contact authorized. V-owned 50ft rope still at Kestrel binding unconscious guard G6 when left; later station conditions unknown. No secure long-term care placement agreed: 3 prepaid nights now finished, 11 survivors need decisions for continuation and three remain immobile. Current V decision: where to take/protect survivors and to whom, if anyone, to show/copy/deliver evidence; alternatives include credible independent oversight or arranging civilian recovery-home assistance, keeping originals private, or seeking formal investigation at real risk. No move after breakfast and no future expenses.
